notes.title: 1 Year Anniversary + Performance Update
notes.content:
🎉 Aestik’s 1 Year Anniversary! 🎉
Today we celebrate one year of Aestik — thank you all SO much for joining us on this journey. 💜

Thanks again for being part of our adventure - we appreciate you! 🥂

notes.title: New Quest Line incl. New Decision + More Accessibility Updates
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43550964/75a4330db3d4e3dd8f5c157b6c1e33297eb370dd.png


Hi folks (:

We’re super pleased to announce that we’ve just updated the demo!

We made some changes in terms of accessibility (yes, Aestik becomes more accessible by the day :D) as well as adding a bit more content for you guys to test out.


[olist] NEW QUEST LINE + NEW DECISION

Introducing Oddfrey on his strange quest to find nihilism in his life 🍡
It's the Oddguy's mission to preach nihilism, but poor Oddfrey stands out among the crowd - he's simply too happy in life. Help him get back on track, find nihilism, and become the true nihilistic self that he yearns to be.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43550964/fb853ed7a3b7355a2fbf0749024400b9f18b6095.png

 SETTINGS MENU

 Aestik now has its very own settings menu! 

With the new update, you will be able to customize your player experience even more as you can now individually adjust the volume of Aestik’s background music as well as SFX. 

After doing some playtesting recently, we became aware of the fact that screenshake can be off-putting or straight-up irritating to some players which is why we implemented the option to turn it off/on if you’d like. 

Also, are you guilty of running Aestik on a computer that is closer to a toaster than the high-end gaming PC of your dreams? We got you covered! We’ve implemented the option to change the game's resolution to … well anything between Aestik-if-it-was-pixel-art and crisp-as-morning-dew -> you choose! 

And lastly, is your eyesight getting worse? Me too, dude. But all jokes aside, too small of a screen or losing your glasses is no longer an issue because the size of the dialogue boxes is finally adjustable - so, happy reading, everyone![/olist]

Anyway, it’s getting late - DON’T FORGET TO WISHLIST AESTIK AND TELL ALL YOUR FRIENDS, FAMILY, PETS AND PLANTS ABOUT IT TOO! 🤍⚔️

Much love,
Julia & Nic

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43550964/41c057707adab2f0452cf6d93a653359ff6e1e52.png

notes.title: Button Rebinding + German Localization Now Available
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43550964/75a4330db3d4e3dd8f5c157b6c1e33297eb370dd.png

Introducing:

Button Rebinding
German Localization
Button Rebinding
An accessibility feature which we wanted to implement for a long time is now finally available for Aestik's public Steam demo: Button Rebinding. 
Now you can choose custom keys and decide which action will be triggered by which button (works on both keyboard and gamepad).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43550964/8f415e9dc83f47c55515d7d70ff9b41d63ef17e1.png

German Localization
Also, the demo is now completely translated into German! This includes all in-game texts, such as the game's menu, the intro cutscene, character dialogue and object descriptions. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43550964/c2e2114cbf1534f7532575fed0ffcda9b6951877.png


✨ Feel free to check out an extended demo (twice the playtime) over on Discord which was also newly updated to feature key rebinding and German localization (:

✨ As always, you can keep up with the latest news on Aestik over on Twitter or through our devlog series on Youtube, see you there! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43550964/41c057707adab2f0452cf6d93a653359ff6e1e52.png
